project_context.name: Nova
project_context.description: AI-powered culinary assistant and management OS for professional kitchens.
project_context.aesthetic: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic. Editorial cookbook meets command center. Minimalist, clean, precision.
project_context.tech_stack: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Tailwind CSS (via CDN or CLI), GSAP, Lenis (No React, pure static build)

rules: Use #F9F9F8 instead of pure white for backgrounds to reduce eye strain and give a premium editorial paper feel.
Surfaces (cards/bento boxes) are pure #FFFFFF for crisp contrast against the off-white background.
Accent color #E04B22 (Chef's Orange) must be used sparingly for high-priority actions and active states only.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers over images. Use backdrop-blur with a slight white tint (#FFFFFF/70).

hierarchy.hero_title: text-6xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[7rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium
hierarchy.caption: text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-secondary

rules: Headings use Cabinet Grotesk for a kinetic, authoritative feel. Tightly tracked.
Use Cormorant Garamond for manifesto chapters, large quotes, or editorial moments (especially italicized).
IBM Plex Sans for all dashboard UI, recipes, and data grids.
Labels, metrics, and overlines must be JetBrains Mono, uppercase, and widely spaced.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic default sans fonts.
Use 2-3x more padding than standard. Sections should breathe.
Mobile-first responsive. Images never exceed 80vh on mobile.
Dashboard uses a strict, dense Bento Grid mode with 1px borders and no border-radius (sharp corners).
Marketing landing page uses highly asymmetric layouts with overlapping images.
Optical alignment is critical. Align text to the visual weight, not just the bounding box.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 lg:gap-6
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_surface: bg-white border border-border/40 shadow-sm rounded-none md:rounded-sm

surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' Glassmorphism for sticky navs: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5.
Use Neumorphism subtly on dashboard widgets: pure white bg, 1px border, very soft shadow.
Clipped Frames: Images should often be placed in non-standard aspect ratios (e.g., tall and narrow 3:4 or ultra-wide 16:5) with sharp corners.

principles: Smooth Scrolling: Lenis is MANDATORY for the entire site to give it a premium, heavy feel.
Masked Line-by-Line Reveal: Use GSAP to animate hero text line by line (clip-path or overflow hidden wrappers).
Parallax/3D: Subtle y-axis movement on hero images and large product photography.
Marquee: Slow, continuous horizontal scroll for the manifesto or ingredient lists.
Hover States: Fast response, slow decay. e.g., transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

components.hero: Kinetic typography, split layout with clipped product photography, subtle GSAP parallax, and masked text reveal loader with signature.
components.marquee: Editorial ribbon, font-serif (Cormorant Garamond), huge text, extremely slow speed, bordered top and bottom.
components.manifesto_chapters: Numbered sections (01, 02) in mono font, followed by massive serif text layout out asymmetrically.
components.dashboard_sidebar: Minimalist, icon + text, high contrast active states, thin 1px right border.
components.chat_interface: Command-line precision meets chat. Clear distinction between user query (natural language) and AI structured output (cards/tables).

rules: Use real product photography, deliberately treated (spotlights, high contrast).
Clip frames: DO NOT round all corners. Use sharp edges or selective rounding to create a curated, editorial layout.

accessibility: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='chat-submit-btn').
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the GSAP animations.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a STATIC HTML/CSS/JS site. DO NOT use React, Vue, or JSX.
Use Tailwind CSS via CDN or compiled CSS. Include GSAP and Lenis via CDN inside the HTML.
The UI has two main parts: The Marketing Landing Page and the App Dashboard. They can be built on a single HTML file using sections, or separate views.
Implement the 'masked line-by-line reveal' loading moment with a signature using GSAP.
Use Cabinet Grotesk, Cormorant Garamond, and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts/Fontshare.
Build the dashboard using CSS Grid (Bento style). No generic Bootstrap layouts.
In the App Dashboard, create a natural language input field (the 'AI OS' interface) that dominates the screen, rather than hiding it in a small corner.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
